component.notes: Native IP candidate: direct persistent TCP to the TV on port 7310. Enable Settings > Channels & Inputs > External Inputs > Serial/IP Control Port. No bridge, Android TV pairing code, or Samsung AccessToken is used. Both profile instances use the same TV IP address. The media routing is retained. Do not use non-persistentTCP or open/close a socket per command: this TV's service stopped responding after early disconnects during discovery. If it stops accepting connections, toggle Serial/IP Control Port off/on using the physical remote. No automatic command retries: a retry can double a relative volume/navigation key. The TV echoes requests and replies with case-sensitive ALL:OkAY, not ALL:OKAY. Power/volume/mute/input queries update states from actual TV responses. Absolute volume uses 101 guarded static-frame helpers (0-100), avoiding assumptions about the engine's checksum algorithms. Helper actions are not user controls. Apps/SmartHub opens Home; direct app launch and other absent actions are unsupported. Other HDMI ports, tuner and legacy keys need validation. Validated on the live TV: volume read/set, volume +/- buttons, mute on/off/read, power read/off, HDMI 1, Home; two simultaneous TCP sessions. See docs/hisense-native-ip.md. Standby disabled TCP networking. A single broadcast Wake-on-LAN packet to UDP 9 woke this TV and power query then returned 0001 without a TCP power-on command. Configure Savant's wake workflow with the TV MAC before TCP PowerOn; these XMLs do not yet emit WOL themselves. TCP PowerOn alone cannot wake this TV in standby. These XMLs still require validation with the installed Savant schema and Blueprint.
